data.name: describe_phenotype
data.summary: Microscopist on 4 field(s): density lower vs DMSO; 7 observations; candidates: unknown

observations.finding: All 4 treated fields (15 uM, 24h) show markedly fewer cells than DMSO field f_4ae3acf45502. DMSO shows flat, spread MCF-7 monolayer with ~60+ cells; f_434a93c4078a and f_53e85790df0c have <10 scorable cells, f_ce9400223061 and f_962298aa325f have fewer clusters and large empty black background. Indicates cell loss/toxicity. Not in top_deviations list - no cell count z provided.

Remaining treated cells are compact, rounded/contracted vs DMSO flat epithelial spread. Nuclei (blue/DAPI) appear condensed and smaller, cytoplasmic footprint reduced. Agrees with cell_major_axis z=-11.42 (62.4 vs 96.2 DMSO median) and nuc_major_axis z=-14.55 (28.3 vs 36.7).

Treated: beta-tubulin (green) is much brighter at identical contrast - rounded cells appear intense yellow/bright green with condensed cytoplasmic signal. DMSO shows dimmer diffuse green filamentous cytoplasm. Agrees with tub_mean z=+15.03 (0.77 vs 0.27).

Treated: F-actin (red) also brighter, especially at cell periphery/basal edge and in contracted tails vs DMSO thin peripheral red. Agrees with act_mean z=+17.16 (0.54 vs 0.30) and act_std z=+36.97 (0.24 vs 0.09).

Treated: tubulin texture much more heterogeneous/punctate (bright condensations vs dark background) and high-contrast, versus smooth diffuse DMSO. Agrees with tub_std z=+30.72 (0.345 vs 0.13) and tub_glcm_contrast z=+66.85 (0.012 vs 0.001). Same for actin: act_glcm_contrast z=+41.68 (0.005 vs 0.001).

Treated cells show loss of normal spread lamellae and frequent elongated thin protrusions/tails, e.g., spindle-like green tails in f_ce9400223061 and f_434a93c4078a. No quantification of shape/protrusions in top_deviations; size decrease only partially captures this. Not covered by measurements.

Treated: no obvious multinucleate giant cells, marked DNA fragmentation, or monopolar spindle rosettes visible in composites (limited resolution, no grayscale DNA channel). Nuclei remain mononucleate, round to ovoid, not enlarged. Not covered by any measurement.

candidate_mechanisms.why: Phenotype is dominated by severe cell loss, rounding/shrinkage and non-specific condensation/brightening of both tubulin and actin, reflected in large mean/std/contrast increases and size decreases. No specific features seen to favor one MoA: no monopolar spindles for Eg5 inhibitors, no enlarged polyploid nuclei for Aurora kinase inhibitors, no DNA-damage-like large nuclei, no clear actin-fiber loss for Actin disruptors nor distinct microtubule bundling/loss that would distinguish Microtubule stabilizers vs destabilizers at this magnitude with only composite images available.

report.uncertainty: high - cytotoxic rounding at 15 uM obscures MoA-specific morphology; only composites provided, no separate grayscale channels to assess filament detail or mitoses reliably. Must not guess compound.

data.note:
Reflection after unblinding — specimen was mevinolin/lovastatin (PubChem CID 53232, synonyms mevinolin/Mevacor, [e27][e28]). ChEMBL CHEMBL503 annotates lovastatin as HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor [e27]; BBBC021 annotates this specimen as Cholesterol-lowering, which code scoring used. My revised conclusion Microtubule stabilizers (p=0.62) was incorrect; initial conclusion Cholesterol-lowering (p=0.58, NSC 3/4 votes similarities 0.65-0.74 at 1.5-15µM [e8][e20]) was correct.

Error: PI prompt emphasized clean 1.5µM profile (442 cells, cell_count z -0.33 yet cell_area z -4.66, cell_major_axis z -6.23 [e4], monotonic tub_mean/act_mean/tub_glcm_contrast rho=1.0 [e9][e21]) with preserved density to argue against generic toxicity/destabilizer/Eg5 and to separate stabilizer bundling. I over-weighted e19 microscopist description (similar density, bright cortical actin rims, heterogeneous punctate tubulin, smaller nuclei, frac_mitotic_like z -4.68, no mitotic increase) and interpreted cortical actin + reduced size as stabilizer bundling.

Lesson: Statins produce exactly this: mevalonate inhibition blocks geranylgeranylation of Rho GTPases controlling cytoskeleton organization and cell morphology PMID 8482726 [e30]. Literature on HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors PMID 3076125 [e29] explains cholesterol-lowering produces strong dose-dependent tub/act texture and shrinkage mimicking stabilizers, but without true mitotic arrest or monopolar spindles. NSC vote across 4 wells should have remained prior; single-well morphology cannot outweigh 3/4 cholesterol-lowering nearest neighbours, especially when e8/e20 neighbours are simvastatin at matched 2-20µM with similarities 0.524-0.654, higher than any stabilizer neighbour.

Next time: trust NSC + dose-response over composite interpretation, test statin cytoskeletal mechanism via mevalonate rescue proposed earlier.

reflection.text:
Unblinded compound mevinolin/lovastatin PubChem CID 53232, ChEMBL 503 = HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor per e27, truth Cholesterol-lowering. Verdict incorrect: final submission Microtubule stabilizers p=0.62 wrong, initial submission Cholesterol-lowering p=0.58 correct before PI-requested re-review.

What evidence got right:
Initially NSC vote over 4 acquired wells e8 gave 3/4 Cholesterol-lowering with similarities 0.65-0.74 at 1.5-15uM. That held on re-test e20 3/4 even when k-neighbour drifted from Eg5 4/10, Cholesterol 2/10, Actin 2/10 to Protein synthesis 3/10, Cholesterol 2/10, Protein degradation 2/10. Dose trends e9 tub_mean rho=+1.00, e10 act_mean rho=+1.00, e11 cell_count rho=-1.00, e16 cell_area rho=-1.00 captured dose-dependent cell shrinkage/rounding with brightening per-pixel tubulin/actin signal. At clean low dose e4 w_960c8e8412 1.5uM: 442 cells, act_glcm_contrast z=+9.4, act_std +8.8, frac_multinucleate_proxy +6.7 but minimal cell loss, and review critique notes cell_count z=-0.33, cell_area z=-4.66, cell_major_axis -6.23. e13 frac_large_nucleus rho=-1.00 and e15 frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.60 p=0.4 correctly argued against DNA damage/polyploidy and Eg5/Aurora mitotic arrest (monoaster/polyploid signatures absent). e26-e28 lookup confirmed name and BBBC021 structure agree and lovastatin is curated HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor, consistent with PMID 3076125 and class reviews PMID 15571475, PMID 31687098.

What misled and why:
1. High-dose texture misread as bundling. e3 15uM w_7e02865f8b 69 cells tub_glcm_contrast +66.8, act_glcm_contrast +41.7, act_std +37.0 and e5 5uM tub_glcm +24.8 drove interpretation of e21 tub_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00, e22 tub_std rho=+1.00, e23 act_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00 as stabilizer-specific microtubule bundling. At high dose these were confounded by cell shrinkage, rounding and sparse sampling (n=69) inflating texture/contrast per pixel, not polymer mass.

2. PI-requested morphology e19 w_960c8e8412 density similar vs DMSO, 3 observations, candidates Actin disruptors, unknown was expanded in rationale to 'bright cortical actin rims and punctate tub heterogeneity without mitotic increase frac_mitotic_large z=-4.68 or large nuclei'. Reviewer critique framed this as preserved spread morphology separating stabilizer from destabilizer and cholesterol-lowering. We overweight that narrative and re-weighted hypotheses in e24 to Microtubule stabilizers 0.62 vs Cholesterol 0.18 despite e20 still voting 3/4 Cholesterol, discounting atlas.

3. Statin cytoskeletal off-target was known but underweighted. PMID 8482726 shows mevalonate controls cytoskeleton organization and cell morphology in epithelial cells and PMID 12951326 links cytoskeletal alterations to downstream signaling. Lovastatin depletion of isoprenoids blocks Rho/Rac geranylgeranylation causing cortical actin remodeling, cell rounding, and apparent tubulin heterogeneity without direct tubulin binding. That explains e9/e10 intensity rises and e21-e23 texture rises as secondary to actin reorganization and shrinkage, not stabilizer bundling. Our e10 act_mean rho=+1.00 actually contradicted actin disruptor loss, but we mapped it to stabilizer instead of recognizing HMG-CoA pathway actin phenotype.

Acquisition/comparison choices at fault:
We acquired only 4 wells at 0.5,1.5,5,15uM from 8 doses 0.015-50uM per e1. Dose_response Spearman on n=4 gives perfect rho +/-1.00 p=0 e9-e11 etc, spurious significance. Missing low doses 0.015-0.15uM where cholesterol-lowering phenotype emerges without toxicity and high dose 50uM toxicity control biased atlas toward k-neighbour Eg5/Protein synthesis. No quantitative monoaster/multipolar spindle count, EB1/tubulin bundling cold-stability, or pHH3 mitotic index was acquired before flipping; e19 was only qualitative. We correctly proposed in first conclusion the discriminating test - mevalonate/geranylgeranyl rescue, filipin staining, RhoA prenylation western - but did not execute, and instead accepted the PI's stabilizer vs destabilizer framing on morphology alone.

Lesson: monotonic tub/act brightening + shrinkage with NSC 3/4 Cholesterol vote should have retained Cholesterol-lowering as top even if k-neighbour noisy; high-contrast texture at cell-count-depleted high doses is not bundling evidence without rescue experiment.

## Reflection

Unblinded compound mevinolin/lovastatin PubChem CID 53232, ChEMBL 503 = HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor per e27, truth Cholesterol-lowering. Verdict incorrect: final submission Microtubule stabilizers p=0.62 wrong, initial submission Cholesterol-lowering p=0.58 correct before PI-requested re-review.

What evidence got right:
Initially NSC vote over 4 acquired wells e8 gave 3/4 Cholesterol-lowering with similarities 0.65-0.74 at 1.5-15uM. That held on re-test e20 3/4 even when k-neighbour drifted from Eg5 4/10, Cholesterol 2/10, Actin 2/10 to Protein synthesis 3/10, Cholesterol 2/10, Protein degradation 2/10. Dose trends e9 tub_mean rho=+1.00, e10 act_mean rho=+1.00, e11 cell_count rho=-1.00, e16 cell_area rho=-1.00 captured dose-dependent cell shrinkage/rounding with brightening per-pixel tubulin/actin signal. At clean low dose e4 w_960c8e8412 1.5uM: 442 cells, act_glcm_contrast z=+9.4, act_std +8.8, frac_multinucleate_proxy +6.7 but minimal cell loss, and review critique notes cell_count z=-0.33, cell_area z=-4.66, cell_major_axis -6.23. e13 frac_large_nucleus rho=-1.00 and e15 frac_mitotic_like rho=+0.60 p=0.4 correctly argued against DNA damage/polyploidy and Eg5/Aurora mitotic arrest (monoaster/polyploid signatures absent). e26-e28 lookup confirmed name and BBBC021 structure agree and lovastatin is curated HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor, consistent with PMID 3076125 and class reviews PMID 15571475, PMID 31687098.

What misled and why:
1. High-dose texture misread as bundling. e3 15uM w_7e02865f8b 69 cells tub_glcm_contrast +66.8, act_glcm_contrast +41.7, act_std +37.0 and e5 5uM tub_glcm +24.8 drove interpretation of e21 tub_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00, e22 tub_std rho=+1.00, e23 act_glcm_contrast rho=+1.00 as stabilizer-specific microtubule bundling. At high dose these were confounded by cell shrinkage, rounding and sparse sampling (n=69) inflating texture/contrast per pixel, not polymer mass.

2. PI-requested morphology e19 w_960c8e8412 density similar vs DMSO, 3 observations, candidates Actin disruptors, unknown was expanded in rationale to 'bright cortical actin rims and punctate tub heterogeneity without mitotic increase frac_mitotic_large z=-4.68 or large nuclei'. Reviewer critique framed this as preserved spread morphology separating stabilizer from destabilizer and cholesterol-lowering. We overweight that narrative and re-weighted hypotheses in e24 to Microtubule stabilizers 0.62 vs Cholesterol 0.18 despite e20 still voting 3/4 Cholesterol, discounting atlas.

3. Statin cytoskeletal off-target was known but underweighted. PMID 8482726 shows mevalonate controls cytoskeleton organization and cell morphology in epithelial cells and PMID 12951326 links cytoskeletal alterations to downstream signaling. Lovastatin depletion of isoprenoids blocks Rho/Rac geranylgeranylation causing cortical actin remodeling, cell rounding, and apparent tubulin heterogeneity without direct tubulin binding. That explains e9/e10 intensity rises and e21-e23 texture rises as secondary to actin reorganization and shrinkage, not stabilizer bundling. Our e10 act_mean rho=+1.00 actually contradicted actin disruptor loss, but we mapped it to stabilizer instead of recognizing HMG-CoA pathway actin phenotype.

Acquisition/comparison choices at fault:
We acquired only 4 wells at 0.5,1.5,5,15uM from 8 doses 0.015-50uM per e1. Dose_response Spearman on n=4 gives perfect rho +/-1.00 p=0 e9-e11 etc, spurious significance. Missing low doses 0.015-0.15uM where cholesterol-lowering phenotype emerges without toxicity and high dose 50uM toxicity control biased atlas toward k-neighbour Eg5/Protein synthesis. No quantitative monoaster/multipolar spindle count, EB1/tubulin bundling cold-stability, or pHH3 mitotic index was acquired before flipping; e19 was only qualitative. We correctly proposed in first conclusion the discriminating test - mevalonate/geranylgeranyl rescue, filipin staining, RhoA prenylation western - but did not execute, and instead accepted the PI's stabilizer vs destabilizer framing on morphology alone.

Lesson: monotonic tub/act brightening + shrinkage with NSC 3/4 Cholesterol vote should have retained Cholesterol-lowering as top even if k-neighbour noisy; high-contrast texture at cell-count-depleted high doses is not bundling evidence without rescue experiment.

What was right:
- e8 and e20 NSC vote 3/4 Cholesterol-lowering
- e13 negative large-nucleus trend and e15 non-significant mitotic fraction correctly excluded Aurora/Eg5/DNA damage
- e4 clean 1.5uM profile with preserved cell number but shrinkage correctly excluded generic toxicity and destabilizer spindle loss

What was wrong or missed:
- e3 e5 e21-e23 extreme tub/act GLCM contrast and std misinterpreted as microtubule stabilizer bundling instead of statin-induced Rho-dependent cortical actin remodeling per PMID 8482726
- e24 re-weighting to Microtubule stabilizers 0.62 despite unchanged NSC vote discounted atlas
- dose_response rho=+1.00 on n=4 wells artifact of limited sampling 0.5-15uM only

Proposed next experiment: Mevalonate/GGPP rescue dose-response 0.5-5uM lovastatin vs DMSO with filipin cholesterol stain, RhoA membrane fractionation, and cold-stable microtubule assay with pHH3 and monoaster counts to separate HMG-CoA dependent rounding from true stabilizer bundling.
